name: Super Normal
effect: You lose Critical Delight's non-crit penalty and never critically fail an attack roll: a natural 1 still misses if it doesn't meet AC, but triggers no fumble effects. Your crit range is 18 to 20, non-crits deal +50% damage, and crits deal triple damage plus PB d20.

name: Still Water
effect: Entering either stance activates both, and you can still counter while in stance. In stance, you take half damage from all sources and can make up to 3 Stand Off counters per round. Each successful counter deflects the attack onto a nearby enemy and adds 1 turn of stored damage (up to PB) to your guaranteed teleporting strike.

name: Elemain's Fancy Criticals
effect: Your ricochets use your Critical Delight crit range (10 to 20) instead of only a natural 20, and each ricochet crit builds and benefits from Critical Delight's multiplier.

name: Shooting Gallery
effect: Each ricochet triggers a Level 3 Travert's Echo (three pulses for 25% of the ricochet's damage in a 10 ft ring around each target hit), and any kill from a ricochet or its echoes banks an echo.

name: Dragnet
effect: Pulled creatures trigger every puddle they're dragged through.

name: Rush Hour
effect: Your echoes gain The Express's hit bonus.

name: Immovable Object
effect: While in stand off, your damage reduction doubles, and counters deal extra damage equal to the damage you reduced this round.

name: Blood and Glory
effect: While Bloodied, Critical Delight's non-crit penalty doesn't apply.

name: Pack Leader
effect: Buff spells you cast on yourself also affect your summon or companion.

name: Contract Kill
effect: Your first hit on a boss each room grants 3 Eyes.

name: Ghost Reaper
effect: Every Reaper's Sprint teleport leaves you hidden.

name: Seismic Waltz
effect: Moving 20 ft detonates any pending Resounding Blows on enemies within 30 ft for 50% damage instead of 40%, and each detonation triggers Echoing Step's 10 ft splash.

name: The Ferryman's Toll
effect: Your execution threshold rises by PB HP for every Soul you hold (up to 10 × PB HP), and executing a creature grants 2 Souls instead of 1.

name: Dead to Rights
effect: Marking a quarry also applies Weak Point with the same bonus action. Your +2d6 mark damage ignores resistance and doubles to +4d6 on a crit, which now triggers on 18 to 20.

name: Blender
effect: Each hit from your bonus action attacks counts as 2 hits toward Thousand Cuts. Against a prone creature, the Stun threshold drops from 4 hits to 3.

name: Martyr's Engine
effect: Spending HP on Bleed Out triggers all of Red Mist's Bloodied effects even if you aren't Bloodied. At 0 HP during Red Mist's extra turn, Bleed Out's Level 3 auto-crit costs no HP and works on every attack that turn.

name: Loaded Dice
effect: When you score a crit or spend a Lucky Break use, Ostra's Coin flips and lands on your called side, triggering both the heal and the necrotic damage.

name: Living Bastion
effect: Using Iron Root plants your Battle Standard in your space for free, with no once-per-room limit, and the standard can't be damaged or knocked over while you stay rooted.

name: Pack Swap
effect: Swapping places with your companion deals 2 × PB force damage to every enemy adjacent to either space and gives your companion a free opportunity attack.

name: Tempest Volley
effect: Scatter Volley can be used once per turn instead of twice per room (up to 3 creatures), and every creature hit suffers both of your chosen Elemental Quiver effects.

name: Hemomancer
effect: Spending HP for Bleed Out releases a 10 ft Cleansing Nova pulse that heals allies for the HP spent and deals that much radiant damage to enemies in it.
